items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Oh yes. The guy’s got all those kids.
Him and his mentor. He’s taking over from Esa-Pekka [Salonen]. You know that?

I heard that orchestra when they did the Bartok concerto for orchestra, before they got into the Latin – it’s the most amazing thing I’ve heard, and it’s been perpetuated. The guy who – the older guy . . .
